summary: Short hint shown on hover or focus of the element it wraps or is anchored to.

usage.text: Wrap the trigger as the first child element (default slot), or use the anchor attribute. It shows on hover after the delay and at once on focus, hides on leave or blur, and fires no events.
Text comes from the content attribute. A child in the content slot replaces it when rich content is needed.
The attribute delay="0" is read as 250. Set the delay property to 0 in script for an immediate tooltip.

a11y.text: It overwrites the trigger's aria-describedby with the id of its tooltip element, which is inside the shadow root where page IDREFs do not resolve. Do not rely on the tooltip for a name or essential text.
